title: Require codec-specific NVENC probe list match
summary: Require the startup NVENC probe to list and runtime-test the configured NVENC encoder, not merely any NVENC encoder.
reason: AV1/NVENC hardware activation must not rely on HEVC/H.264 NVENC availability as proof that av1_nvenc is listed and runnable on the executing host.
behavior_before: Test-NvencAvailable accepted any listed NVENC encoder before runtime probing the configured TestEncoder, so a build listing HEVC/H.264 NVENC could pass the list gate for an AV1/NVENC configuration.
behavior_after: Test-NvencAvailable requires an exact list match for the configured TestEncoder before runtime probing that same encoder; missing AV1/NVENC support can force CPU fallback instead of being inferred from other NVENC encoders.

ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncoderRuntimeMatrixChecks.ps1 - passed (3 CPU rows executed, 9 hardware rows list-only skipped by default)
rollback_plan: Revert the exact NVENC list-match helper, restore the broad any-NVENC regex, remove the targeted assertions, revert active-doc wording, and refresh generated summaries.
